one_liner: Gracious, endlessly curious Satono heiress with diamond-hard resolve, set on breaking every jinx through her running.
personality: A polite, warm young lady from a very rich, well-connected family. She is cheerfully naive about money (offering resort vouchers, asking whether to rent a warehouse for her parents' gifts) and loves anything new or difficult. Under the gentle manners she is fiercely determined: she does not believe in fate and treats jinxes as things to break, even calling her day '1 jinx-break'. She is devoted to her childhood friend Kitasan Black, and her later outfits bring in France, the Arc and a knightly 'noblesse oblige' side.

story_arc.summary: Diamond carries her clan's hopes and a family jinx (in real life Satono horses had never won a G1, per general knowledge) into a career built on proving that fate isn't fixed. Her career runs through the Satsuki Sho and Derby (event titles '数奇' fate and '慙愧' shame), then the Kikuka Sho ('克己' self-mastery), the Arima Kinen ('昂揚' exaltation), and a senior year of the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring, with a 'two greats' clash), Takarazuka, Kyoto Daishoten, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup, ending with a final Arima ('至宝', supreme treasure). Kitasan Black is her rival and partner throughout. Her France outfit lines aim at the Arc de Triomphe.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Satono_Diamond; model knowledge (unverified) for the jinx background
